items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] With Hoagy Carmichael and his orchestra. [INTERVIEWEE] Hoagy Carmichael. ... [INTERVIEWER] With Carmichael and one of the things you played was 'Stardust'. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, that's right. I did that.

ctx.x: And it was "Georgia On My Mind", "Bessie Couldn't Help It" and "One Night in Havana! And you made that record with Bix.
